articles.title: Eastern Europe crypto flows fall 7.9% as Ukraine draws $12B in stablecoins
articles.description: Chainalysis found that Eastern Europe recorded the steepest decline in crypto activity of any region, while cross-border stablecoin transfers to Ukraine continued amid the ongoing war.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
articles.description: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

articles.title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
articles.description: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

articles.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
articles.description: The company confirmed that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president.

articles.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
articles.description: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

articles.title: Apple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, and more, hit by outage
articles.description: Apple's status page confirms its services are facing outages, but has not confirmed the cause.

articles.title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
articles.description: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

articles.title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
articles.description: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.

articles.title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
articles.description: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

articles.title: Lighter incident exposes risks beyond withdrawal controls
articles.description: Crypto platforms need enforceable limits on every route an API key can use to transfer value, including trades, internal transfers and shared pools.

articles.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
articles.description: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

articles.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
articles.description: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

articles.title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
articles.description: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

articles.title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
articles.description: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.

articles.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
articles.description: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

articles.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
articles.description: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

articles.title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
articles.description: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.

articles.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
articles.description: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

articles.title: Meta launches Direct, a stand-alone messaging app for Instagram
articles.description: Direct is launching in Turkey and Thailand, and can be used with or without an Instagram account.
